scope: Posts and Pages responsive editor geometry plus a real 5,000-word publication guard; preserves v313 Nara, v312 Theme/Members/Domain, v311 onboarding, and the existing Studio sidebar authority.
notes: The editor no longer reserves a 980px blank sheet for a new draft; the writing surface expands naturally as content grows.
Desktop-site, laptop, computer and large-tablet layouts keep the inspector beside the document; compact devices keep all settings below the writing surface.
Application, handphone, mobile and compact-device layouts keep Preview/Terbitkan readable, tabs and toolbar scrollable, and the HTML source modal inside the viewport.
The 5,000-word rule never deletes or truncates a draft. It only prevents publication until the content returns within the configured limit.
This release does not claim universal real-device perfection or extreme login capacity without measured production tests.
